assertion: Backdrop invert, multiply and opacity must preserve their compositing order. Controls use full, half and zero opacity; the final box has no foreground content and must not multiply the filtered page by the original page again.

browser.reason: Reviewed before/after colors and difference images; see README.md beside this case. The double multiplication is fixed. Chrome preserves the filtered backdrop, blends foreground with it, then composites normally. Only the full-opacity translucent background differs by one blue-channel level over 16000 pixels (31 versus 32). Firefox/WebKit captures omit even the invert-only backdrop control in this environment; their agreement does not arbitrate this combination.
